# Codex Trajectory v0.4.1

This patch improves readability in desktop reports and live side panels and includes the viewer fixes merged since v0.4.0.

- Increase report body text to 15px and small report/live-panel text to at least 12px. Move the inspector below the ledger in narrower panels, preserve readable table columns with horizontal scrolling, and wrap live-panel controls and Token details (#9, fixes #8).
- Keep session selection, live-window, and refresh actions reachable when a task has a long title (#6).
- Initialize the native MCP Apps viewer before waiting for host results, handle delayed legacy results, and expose a recoverable initialization error (#7).
- Target Codex desktop surfaces and desktop Chromium browsers; mobile layouts are no longer supported (#4).
- Close expected HTTP error responses in acceptance tests and check Python 3.14 resource-leak warnings in CI (#5).

No trajectory schema, pricing, or privacy-default changes are introduced in this patch. The optional local CDP integration remains off by default.

After updating the plugin, open a new Codex task to load the updated viewer. The readability fix was visually checked with synthetic data in macOS Chromium and exercised at six panel widths and device scale factors 1 and 2. Windows CI does not replace a manual check of the reporter's exact Windows Codex setup.
